definitions.graph: Nodes are living particles; linkedComponents count connected components of size >=2; isolatedParticles are unlinked living particles; largestComponent is 0 when there are no edges. Graph components are not organisms, offspring, or mutation units.
definitions.isolatedFraction: isolatedParticles divided by population; null at zero population. liveEdgeFraction is (nodes - isolatedParticles) / population, the living-particle share incident to at least one live edge; null at zero population.
definitions.meanDegree: 2 × live edge count / living population; null at zero population. Median live-edge age uses completed-tick convention age = currentTick - bornTick + 1; null when no edge exists.
definitions.edgeLifetimes: Removal event records include cause and stage. completedTicks is the number of completed ticks for which the edge existed: stretch/dead-end removals before a step use the prior completed tick; death cleanup after base.step includes the tick where endpoint death occurred.
definitions.thresholds: For descriptive labels only, a median live-edge age >= 100 ticks is persistent at the sampling interval scale; a median completed lifetime < 100 ticks among removed edges is rapid churn. Null medians mean there is no basis for the label.
definitions.suppliedSteering: netImpulseMagnitude is the cumulative sum over ticks of each particle’s magnitude of its net added velocity impulse. It is supplied steering, not physical work, energy, or an energy-ledger term. Interval rows store cumulative differences.
definitions.ledger: Residual = particleEnergy + foodEnergy + dissipated + deathLoss - initial - renewed. It is checked each tick against absolute tolerance 1e-6. It excludes steering by design.
definitions.checks: Every tick validates finite particle/food/ledger/summary values, positions in [0,1), particle speed <= base speedMax + 1e-12 after the base step, particle energy in [0,maxEnergy], population <= 240, food stock in [0,35] with 1e-9 tolerance, edge endpoint/self/duplicate/family/degree rules, and absolute ledger residual <=1e-6.
definitions.sampling: Base census and graphSummary are stored at tick 0, each 100 completed ticks, and exact extinction. Per-tick checks and cumulative impulse differences run every living tick. None mode full base snapshots are compared with a directly stepped ParticleWorld at tick 0 and every sampled/final point.
definitions.comparison: Within each seed, none/chains/mesh share the same initial base snapshot. Different seeds are independent. None-mode snapshots are full exact snapshot comparisons to a direct ParticleWorld; extension metadata is not compared.
definitions.stops: All six bonded runs extinct before tick 1000 is recorded as the prespecified early-collapse stop. All nine fixed runs are retained. Invalid invariant data aborts the batch; no tuning, rescue, or parameter search is performed.
definitions.limits: Descriptive engineered toy evidence. Bonds are supplied nearest-first engineering with deterministic tie breaks; they are not emergent organisms. Same-runtime seeded replay only. This artifact does not include a visual judgment.
